questions: Have you noticed any weakness or drooping on one side of your face?
Do you have pain or tenderness in your forehead?
Do you have a severe headache?
Do you have trouble closing one of your eyes?
Have you had a rash on your face or ear?
Have you had a recent cold or viral infection?
Do you have pain in your jaw when chewing?
Have you noticed any changes in your vision?
Do you have ringing in your ears or hearing loss?
Does part of your face feel numb?
Have you noticed any change in your sense of taste?
